description: Well-run open-source repositories the scanner rules are calibrated on. When a strong project fails a check, either it really lacks the practice or the rule is wrong.

repos.why: Agent framework with an agent harness, skills and strict CI.
Agent SDK of an LLM vendor, with AGENTS.md and a broad test suite.
Reference SDK of the Model Context Protocol, built with coding agents.
Young agent SDK: shows how the rules treat a short history.
Popular agent library with many outside contributors.
Mature CLI library that calls no LLM: LLM checks must be not applicable.
Mature HTTP client with a long history and no agent conventions.
Mature library, mostly one maintainer: tests the Code Review rules.
Project template with Docker and CI; commits a .env of template values.
